question_en: Rao Bahadur Sir A.T. Pannirselvam was a ____________ leader, who previously served in the Governor Erskine's Executive council.
question_ta: ராவ் பகதூர் சர் அ.த. பன்னீர்செல்வம் ____________ தலைவராக இருந்தார், இதற்கு முன்பு ஆளுநர் எர்ஸ்கினின் நிர்வாகக் குழுவில் பணியாற்றினார்.
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
Sir A.T. Pannirselvam was a prominent and loyal leader of the Justice Party (South Indian Liberal Federation). He served in the Executive Council of Lord Erskine, the Governor of Madras, during the 1930s.

---

question_en: According to Valluvar, what is Venmai (Stupidity)?

A.en: Arrogance that cries, "Behold we claim that glory of wise"
A.ta: தாம் அறிவொளி படைத்தவர்கள் என்று நினைக்கும் செருக்கு

B.ta: உடம்பை ஆடையால் மறைப்பது போல குற்றங்களை மறைத்தல்

C.en: Fools think what they know is knowledge serene and pretend

D.en: The shallow who are lazy to listen to wise counsel

subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
In Kural 844 ("வெண்மை எனப்படுவது யாதெனின் ஒண்மை உடையம்யாம் என்றுசெருக்கு"), Valluvar explains that stupidity (Venmai) is the pride/arrogance of claiming, "We possess the light of wisdom."

question_en:
What are the things "Being with Kings, Discerning unspoken thoughts, knowing the audience", stated in these Chapters by Thiruvalluvar?
  (1) About Minister's behaviour
  (2) Minister's advised to King
  (3) How a king should treat another King
  (4) Related Psychology Ideas
question_ta:
“மன்னரைச் சேர்ந்தொழுகுதல், குறிப்பறிதல், அவையறிதல்” ஆகிய அதிகாரங்களில் வள்ளுவர் உணர்த்துவன யாவை?
  (1) அமைச்சரின் நடத்தை பற்றியது
  (2) அமைச்சர் மன்னனுக்கு ஆலோசனை வழங்குவது
  (3) மன்னன் பிற மன்னர்களோடு நடந்து கொள்ள வேண்டிய முறை பற்றியது
  (4) உளவியல் கருத்துக்கள் நிறைந்தது
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
These chapters under Porutpal describe code of conduct for ministers/courtiers in royal courts (1), advising the ruler (2), and reading micro-expressions/body language which involves psychological principles (4). They do not deal with inter-state relations between kings (3).

---

question_en:
Makkale Polvar 'Kayavar' Avaranna
  Oppaari yaanganta thil:
  - In this verse who is mentioned as Kayavar?
question_ta:
மக்களே போல்வர் ‘கயவர்’ அவரன்ன
  ஒப்பாரி யாங்கண்ட தில்
  - என்ற குறளில் ‘கயவர்’ என யாரைக் குறிப்பிடுகின்றார்?
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
In Kural 1071, Valluvar compares base people (Kayavar) to ordinary humans because they look similar outwardly. However, they lack morals, act solely on personal whims, display no sense of responsibility, and lead an aimless/unprincipled life. Thus, all characteristics apply.

---

question_en: According to Valluvar instruction, "The person who follows an ascetic life", what should be done to avoid contempt?
question_ta: 'துறவிகளுக்கு இகழ்ச்சி வராமல் இருக்க' அவர்கள் என்ன ஒழுக்கம் மேற்கொள்ள வேண்டும் என்று வள்ளுவர் கூறுகிறார்?
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
In Kural 281 ("எள்ளாமை வேண்டுவான் என்பான் எனைத்தொன்றும் கள்ளாமை காக்கதன் நெஞ்சு"), Valluvar says that one who wishes to live free of contempt/scorn (Ellamai) must guard their heart against stealing (Kallamai).

---

question_en: To whom wealth compared to the full water of city tank?
question_ta: 야ருடைய செல்வத்தை வள்ளுவர் நீர் நிறைந்த ஊருணியோடு ஒப்பிடுகிறார்?
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
In Kural 215 ("ஊருணி நீர்நிறைந் தற்றே உலகவாம் பேரறி வாளன் திரு"), the wealth of a wise, benevolent person (man of eminent knowledge) is compared to a village tank filled with drinking water, serving the needs of everyone.

---

question_en: Who is the author of the Novel "Kaagetha Sangiligal"?
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
"Kaagetha Sangiligal" (Paper Chains) is a famous medical-drama novel written by Sujatha (whose real name is S. Rangarajan). It deals with kidney transplantation and family dynamics, and was adapted into the film *Poi Mugangal*.

---

question_en:
Match the authors with their magazines:
  Author - Magazine
  (a) Jeyakanthan - 1. Thendral
  (b) Na. Parthasarathy - 2. Annam Vidu Thoothu
  (c) Kannadasan - 3. Gnanaratham
  (d) Meera - 4. Deepam
  (a) (b) (c) (d)
question_ta:
ஆசிரியர்களை அவர்களது இதழ்களுடன் பொருத்துக:
  ஆசிரியர் - இதழ்கள்
  (a) ஜெயகாந்தன் - 1. தென்றல்
  (b) நா. பார்த்தசாரதி - 2. அன்னம் விடு தூது
  (c) கண்ணதாசன் - 3. ஞானரதம்
  (d) மீரா - 4. தீபம்
  (a) (b) (c) (d)
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
- Jeyakanthan was associated with *Gnanaratham* (3).
  - Na. Parthasarathy founded and edited *Deepam* (4).
  - Kannadasan ran the magazine *Thendral* (1).
  - Meera (M. Rajendran) edited *Annam Vidu Thoothu* (2).

---

question_en: Which work refers to the war at 'Kazhumalam'?
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
The battle of Kazhumalam, fought between Chera king Kanaikkal Irumporai and Chola king Kochangannan, is detailed in *Agananooru* (verse 44).

question_en:
Malaiyulae pirapinum malaiku avaitham en seiyum
  - In which book does these lines occur?
question_ta:
“மலையுளே பிறப்பினும் மலைக்கு
  அவைதாம் என் செய்யும்”
  - என்ற பாடல் வரிகள் இடம் பெற்ற நூல் எது?
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
These lines are from *Kalithogai* (Palaikkali, verse 9). They use the metaphor of sandalwood (which grows on a mountain but is of no use to the mountain itself, but only to those who wear it) to describe a daughter who belongs to her husband's family after marriage.

question_en: Dakhni literature was patronised by the Qutb Shahi Sultans of
question_ta: தாக்கினி இலக்கியம் குதுப் ஷாகி சுல்தான் ____________ ஆல் ஆதரிக்கப்பட்டது
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
Dakhni (Deccani Urdu) literature received extensive royal patronage from the Qutb Shahi dynasty of Golkonda, especially under Sultan Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah, who was himself an acclaimed poet of the language.

question_en: According to Valluvar which one is compared to hand of one whose garment is loosened?
question_ta: உடுக்கை இழந்தவன் கைபோலே என்பதற்கு வள்ளுவர் எதனை ஒப்பிடுகிறார்?
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
In Kural 788 ("உடுக்கை இழந்தவன் கைபோல ஆங்கே இடுக்கண் களைவதாம் நட்பு"), Valluvar compares true friendship to the immediate, instinctive movement of a hand to catch a slipping garment to prevent embarrassment.

question_en:
Thirukkural has got 'Quality of Religious Equity'
  - The reason for this remark.
  (i) Accepted by all religious people as theirs
  (ii) Accepted by both theists and atheists
  (iii) Kural is beyond race, caste, religion, sect.
  (iv) Kural teaches all virtues to Mankind
question_ta:
'சமய நடுநிலைப் பண்பு' கொண்டது திருக்குறள்
  - என்பார் கூற்றுக்குக் காரணம்.
  (i) எல்லாச் சமயத்தவரும் இது எம் நூல் என்று கூறும் சிறப்புப்பெற்றதால்
  (ii) கடவுள் உண்டு என்பவர் மட்டுமின்றி இல்லை என்பவரும் உவந்து ஏற்கும் சிறப்புப்பெற்றதால்
  (iii) இனம், சாதி, சமயம், வகுப்பு எல்லாவற்றிற்கும் அப்பாற்பட்டதால்
  (iv) மனித இனத்திற்குப் பொதுவான ஒழுக்கமும் அறிவும் அறிவுறுத்தப்படுவதால்
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
Thirukkural exhibits religious equity because it avoids aligning with any specific god, ritual, or sect. It is accepted by all religions as their own (i), appeals equally to theists and non-theists (ii), transcends all divisions of caste, race, or sect (iii), and defines ethical principles universal to all humanity (iv).

---

question_en: Why is Thirukkural called, 'Ulaga Pothumarai' (Universal Book of Principles)?

A.en: It is translated in many languages

D.en: It has principles common for all, irrespective of country, religion and time

subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
Thirukkural is revered as 'Ulaga Pothumarai' (Universal Creed/Public Scripture) because its moral teachings are universal and timeless, applying to all people regardless of their nation, religion, caste, language, or era.

---

question_en: Who is the poet for the verse "Pottruvaar Pottrattum..."?
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
The lines "போற்றுவார் போற்றட்டும் புழுதிவாரித் தூற்றுவார் தூற்றட்டும்..." (Let those who praise, praise; let those who slander, slander...) is a famous philosophical poem written by Kavignar Kannadasan about resilience and detaching from public opinion.

---

question_en: The life line of Thirukkural is reverence for life towards all the living beings on the earth. This idea was perpetrated because

A.en: It insists that we should think of the suffering of others as our own

B.en: It insists that we not do to others what we think is bad

C.en: It insists that we never do any harm to others even if we think its very small

subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
Reverence for life in Thirukkural is established by: feeling another's suffering as one's own and attempting to alleviate it (A), refraining from doing anything to others that one finds harmful (B), and committing to not cause even the smallest harm to any creature (C). Therefore, all aspects contribute.

---

question_en:
"...... than neermai kunrum thatindhthezhili
  thaan nalkaathaaki vitin" - What reduces in the mention above Thirukkural, by Thiruvalluvar?
  (.... wealth will waste away except the cloud its stores repay)
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
In Kural 17 ("நெடுங்கடலும் தன்நீர்மை குன்றும் தடிந்தெழிலி தான் நல்கா தாகி விடின்"), Valluvar explains that even the vast ocean (Great sea) will lose its richness and diminish if the rain-bearing clouds do not return water to it by raining.

---

question_en:
".....ivvirandum
  kanenba vazhum uyirku" these two are the eyes of human beings"
  Which of the following pair is compared to eyes of all human beings?
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
In Kural 392 ("எண்ணென்ப ஏனை எழுத்தென்ப இவ்விரண்டும் கண்ணென்ப வாழும் உயிர்க்கு"), Valluvar declares that numbers (science/mathematics) and letters (literature/language) are the two eyes of a living human being.

---

question_en: The attitude of Rama to accept joy and sorrows equally is compared to a flower by Kamban. Which is the flower?
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
In Kamba Ramayanam, when Rama is told he will not be crowned king and must instead go to the forest for 14 years, his face remains serene and radiant. Kamban describes it as: "சித்திரத்தினில் அலர்ந்த செந்தாமரையினை ஒத்தது முகத்தின் பொலிவு" (His face resembled a red lotus freshly bloomed in a painting).

---

question_en: Which is the excellent description of "Maruthanilam Nanda Villakam" based on Chitrilakkiyam?
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
Pallu, a genre of Chitrilakkiyam (minor Tamil literary forms), depicts the agricultural lifestyle and rural culture of the Marutham landscape (fertile plains). It is poetically referred to as "Maruthanila Nanda Vilakkam".

---

question_en:
Find out whose statement is this?
  Like a bird that flies to a tree bearing fruit, I went to the broad palace of Karikal's court.
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
In *Porunaraatrupadai* (one of the Pathupattu texts composed by the poetess Mudathamakanniyar in praise of Chola king Karikalan), she describes entering the magnificent court of Karikalan just like birds flocking to a tree heavy with ripe fruits.

---

question_en: Which Pathupattu literature is also called as "Nenjatrupadai"?
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
*Mullaippaattu*, the shortest of the Pathupattu (Ten Idyls) poems written by Nappoodhanaar, is also known as "Nenjatrupadai" (guiding the heart).

question_en:
Choose the right matches among the following :
  (1) Vedanta — Fountain Head of Indian philosophy
  (2) Brahmanas — Musical Hymns
  (3) Rigveda — Gayatri mantra
  (4) Puranas — Upanishad
question_ta:
சரியான பொருத்தங்களைத் தேர்ந்தெடு :
  (1) வேதாந்தம் — இந்திய தத்துவத்தின் நீரூற்று
  (2) பிராமணங்கள் — இசைப் பாடல்கள்
  (3) ரிக் வேதம் — காயத்ரி மந்திரம்
  (4) புராணங்கள் — உபநிடதம்
subject: Art & Culture
explanation_en:
- (1) Vedanta (Upanishads) is widely regarded as the fountainhead of classical Indian philosophical systems (Correct).
  - (2) Brahmanas explain the prose texts and rituals of the Vedas (Samaveda contains the musical hymns) (Incorrect).
  - (3) Rigveda contains the famous Gayatri Mantra in its third Mandala (Correct).
  - (4) Puranas are encyclopedic mythological narratives, distinct from the philosophical Upanishads (Incorrect).

---
